t: Lug quality: golden rule standard + improve-before-notify workflow
challenge: Lugs are written tersely and the improve skill is skipped. The user receives a lug notification before improve has run, meaning they see incomplete work. Terse lugs create invisible gaps for the next agent.
hypothesis: Two rules codified in wai-lug-schema.md authoring section and wai-improve trigger: (1) Golden Rule — write every lug as if the next reader has zero context; body must explain situation, rationale, scope, references. (2) Improve-Before-Notify — run improve skill before telling the user a lug is done. The notification IS the signal of completion, not the write.
next_step: add golden rule to wai-lug-schema.md authoring section; add improve-before-notify trigger rule to wai-improve.md

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Improvement idea: lug quality standard and improve workflow enforcement.
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to implement immediately without user direction.

resolution_note: Captured in PEV gate rule + lug-before-showing feedback. Already enforced.
